properties.name: Mae Sai core - town, border crossing and Sai River strip
properties.name_th: แม่สาย (เขตเมืองและแนวแม่น้ำสาย)
properties.event_name: Chiang Rai / Mae Sai flood, September 2024
properties.adm3_covered: Full: TH570901 Mae Sai, TH570906 Wiang Phang Kham. Partial: TH570904 Pong Pha (~43%), TH570905 Si Mueang Chum (~27%), TH570903 Ko Chang (~9%).
properties.derivation: Union of the committed HDX COD-AB ADM3 boundaries for Mae Sai and Wiang Phang Kham in outputs/mae_sai_admin_context.geojson, the two subdistricts on the Sai River border strip that took the worst September 2024 inundation.
properties.purpose: Primary study area. Verify 42 OSM-derived candidate facilities and the bridge/road segments that drive the access-loss model, and give the Sentinel-1 SAR change detector an optical false-positive screen.

requested_windows.label: Immediate pre-event baseline
requested_windows.measured_evidence: 2024-09-05 measured at 12.5% AOI cloud (AOI-01) and 14.7% (AOI-02), at 100% AOI coverage.
requested_windows.note: Five days before the flood peak. Seasonally matched to the event, so it pairs far better for change detection than a January baseline. Highest-value single date for this event.

requested_windows.label: Flood event window
requested_windows.measured_evidence: Every Sentinel-2 date in this window is heavily obscured. Flood peak 2024-09-10 at 100% AOI cloud; best in window 2024-09-30 at 89.2% (AOI-02). No date below 80%.
requested_windows.note: Requested only in case THEOS-2 caught a break that Sentinel-2 missed. A null result here is expected and is not a problem.

requested_windows.label: Post-event clear baseline
requested_windows.note: Best window for facility and road verification. Post-monsoon and before the northern biomass-burning haze season.

requested_windows.label: Early post-event baseline
requested_windows.revision: split out of the original W3
requested_windows.note: Closer to the event than W3. Preferred if post-flood recovery state matters more than maximum clarity.

properties.cloud_metric: max_cloud_pct is the AOI-clipped Sentinel-2 SCL measurement from scripts/scout_theos2_aoi_cloud.py and is what determines whether an acquisition is usable. portal_scene_cloud_filter_pct is the scene-level value to enter in the GISTDA ordering portal, which filters over the whole satellite footprint rather than the AOI; entering the AOI value there would discard usable dates. See outputs/theos2_aoi_cloud_scout.csv and outputs/theos2_portal_cloud_thresholds.csv.
properties.redistribution_intent: None. Imagery stays in a controlled workspace outside version control. Only derived, checksum-tracked evidence is committed.
